title: Will the number of distinct US states Donald Trump has visited (per VISITAREA rules) be at least 22 in Oct 2026?
rules: If the number of distinct US states Donald Trump has visited (per VISITAREA rules) is at least 22 in Oct 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
VISITAREA contract: https://kalshi-public-docs.s3.amazonaws.com/contractterms/VISITAREA.pdf

The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.

blind.reasoning: Through about Oct 20, 2026, the October stops I could find are Tennessee, Georgia, Kansas and North Carolina, probably Texas, plus Maryland (Air Force One flies from Joint Base Andrews) and likely Florida. That is around 7–10 states, and he keeps repeating states such as Texas and North Carolina. Reaching 22 would need about a dozen new states in the last 11 days. Even his heavier near-daily October 2018 schedule, as I recall it, got only about 20.
blind.falsifier: An announced final-week schedule of near-daily, multi-state rallies (two or three new states a day) across Senate battlegrounds such as Michigan, Ohio, Iowa, Maine, New Hampshire, Alaska and Nebraska, pushing October's distinct-state total to 22 or more.

final.reasoning: The market at 64.5% likely reflects a fuller tally of early-October stops that my search, which ran out early, couldn't see, so I've moved sharply up from 9%. My remaining doubt about reaching 22 distinct states isn't strong enough to justify betting against better-informed traders.
